dedupe_keys.name: virtual testbed for model predictive control development in district cooling systems

description: Zabala, Laura and colleagues publish this resource through the native repository. The implemented virtual plant includes compressor and absorption chillers and cooling towers built in Modelica, calibrated using manufacturer information and operating measurements. Python represents the remainder of the plant. Machine-learning and state-space reductions connect the component models to a computationally fast predictive controller. Simulation experiments compare primary-energy minimization with standard cascade control and report savings up to fifty percent under the tested conditions. Related field validation is documented separately; simulated savings are not labelled universal measured savings. Zenodo publishes the record with open access and a native licence label of cc-by-4.0. Source metadata and file descriptors were inspected; no linked files, model archives, code or documentation bodies were opened. Coverage and validation are limited to the stated model, data or application. Publication date does not establish current software maintenance.
